transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I think dispatch and compliance have been tracking my route changes through the computer system. There are little comments on the radio too, and I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me, even though people keep saying it’s just normal oversight.
How long have you been noticing these things happening with dispatch and the other drivers?
About two months now. That’s when the computer tracking and the comments on the radio started feeling pretty clear to me.
Have you heard any voices or sounds when no one is around, or that others cannot hear?
No, I haven’t heard voices or sounds when nobody else is there.
Over these past two months, how has your mood been?
I’m not really sure what you mean by my mood. I’ve mostly been focused on what’s been going on at work.
Have you ever felt like someone or something outside of yourself was putting thoughts into your head, or controlling your body?

No, not like they’re putting thoughts in my head or controlling my body. It’s more that dispatch and compliance are tracking what I do—the route changes, the radio comments—and I can tell some of the other drivers are reporting on me.
Have you been using any recreational drugs recently?
I’m not sure what you mean by recreational drugs. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Do you have any physical medical conditions?
I don’t think so. I haven’t been told I have any medical conditions.
Before these past two months, did you generally find it difficult to trust other people?
I’m not sure. I mean, I usually just took people as they were, I guess.
